newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: ALPINE SKIING-WOMEN'S WORLD CUP DOWNHILL CALLED OFF.
newsitem.headline: ALPINE SKIING-WOMEN'S WORLD CUP DOWNHILL CALLED OFF.

text.p: Rain and heavy fog forced organisers to call off a women's World Cup downhill race on Friday.
The biggest obstacle facing race officials was the constant drizzle that had made the Mont Lachaux course soft and dangerous.
The decision to call off the downhill also wipes out the first combined event of the season. A slalom was due to be held here on Saturday.
No immediate decision was made on when or if the race would be re-scheduled and organisers said they would make an announcement later on Friday about Saturday's programme.
